files.title: Facultad de Bellas Artes - Universidad del Atlántico (Bquilla - BellasArtes.jpg, 2007)
files.author: José David Villalobos

notes: Both verified as the Facultad de Bellas Artes de la Universidad del Atlántico, Barranquilla (historic sede in the El Prado heritage complex; inscription 'UNIVERSIDAD DEL ATLÁNTICO / FACULTAD DE BELLAS ARTES' visible on façade). photo-1: frontal garden view of the restored main façade (July 2025, just after the 2025 restoration reopening) — symmetrical two-storey front with central portico of columns, arched upper windows with balustraded balcony. photo-2: oblique 2007 view from the gardens showing the arched loggia with blue awnings along the side elevation and hipped tile roof. IMPORTANT FLAG for atlas editors: the building is neocolonial-revival in character (arcades, hip roofs), NOT 'mid-20th-century modernist concrete' as stated in the task brief — identification by institution is certain, but parent-session description may need review or may refer to a different structure on the campus.

rejected.title: Sede Bellas Artes.jpg
rejected.reason: Shows a different white Republican-style mansion with Universidad Metropolitana/Americana signage — not the Facultad de Bellas Artes of Universidad del Atlántico despite its Commons title/description.
